dedupe_keys.name: enerocc occupancy driven building energy cost and carbon emission analysis software

description: Mohammad Gheibi, Reza Yeganeh Khaksar and Amirhossein Hoshyar publish EnerOcc, a single-file application for occupancy-dependent building energy, cost and carbon analysis. The July 2026 Zenodo deposit offers EnerOcc.m free under CC BY 4.0. It models occupancy effects using end-use elasticities, fuel allocation, photovoltaic self-consumption, prices and emissions factors, and displays scenario results through a dashboard. The model can provide rapid demand and economic comparisons before more detailed building simulations. Coverage is a user-defined building, not a specified monitored facility. The MATLAB filename identifies the implementation family, but required release, toolboxes, equations and validation data are not documented on the page. Related catalogue record model-enertwin-occupancy-building-energy is a separate same-author application with overlapping functions; equivalence is not established. Numerical uncertainty and physical calibration remain unknown. The code was not downloaded or executed.
